name: whisper-medium-karakalpak
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-medium (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of openai/whisper-medium, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.764 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-08.

benchmarks.name: Karakalpak Speech Corpus test WER % (greedy)
benchmarks.config: Card table '## Comparison with other Karakalpak ASR systems (test split, greedy decoding)', row 'whisper-medium-karakalpak (this model)' 10.66 (95% CI 10.03-11.36) vs row 'openai/whisper-medium, zero-shot' 91.27 (89.71-93.12), same table, same split (1,074 utts / 5.3 h). CAVEAT printed by the card: the test set is in-domain for this model (same text sources and recording pipeline as training) and out-of-domain for every baseline, so the gap reflects domain match as well as model quality. Karakalpak is not a Whisper language; the base runs on an auto-detected/proxy language token.
